metrics.label: GMV
metrics.description: 已支付订单的实付金额合计。包含之后整单退款的订单，不包含已取消（未支付）订单。

notes: 数据范围：华东（行级权限由系统强制执行，结果只包含你有权限的数据）。

answer.text: 上个月（2026年9月），GMV最高的渠道是小程序（60,515.89 元），最低的是App（30,156.47 元）。

queries.title: GMV
queries.sql:
SELECT
  o.channel AS channel,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  o.channel
ORDER BY
  gmv DESC,
  channel
LIMIT 1000
queries.executed_sql:
SELECT
  o.channel AS channel,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE
    region_id IN ('east')
) AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  o.channel
ORDER BY
  gmv DESC,
  channel
LIMIT 1000
